subject: general
question: Which one of the following is NOT a basic principle of Micro Finance Institutions in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Large amounts of loans.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **large amount of loan **is not a basic principle of micro-financial institutions in India.
 
• The functions of Microfinance institutions are:
 
 
• **Maintain macroeconomic stability.**
 
• **Avoid interest-rate caps.**
 
• **Refrain from distorting the market with unsustainable subsidized.**
 
• **High-delinquency loan programs**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• MFIs are **financial companies that provide small loans to people who do not have any access to banking facilities**. 
 
• The definition of “small loans” varies between countries. In India, all loans that are below Rs. 1 lakh can be considered as microloans.
 
• **Various types of institutions offer microfinance**: 
 
 
• **​C******r**edit unions.**
 
• **Commercial banks.**
 
• **NGOs (Non-governmental Organizations).**
 
• **Cooperatives, and sectors of government banks**.
 
 
 
• The emergence of “for-profit” MFIs is growing. In India, these 'for-profit' MFIs are referred to as Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFC).
